question: How should the utility receive the text to normalize?
why_it_matters: The input channel determines invocation behavior and which missing-input cases must be tested.
recommendation_reason: Exactly one file path gives this small local utility a clear, deterministic interface and bounded error cases.

options.description: Accept exactly one file path; do not support stdin.
Accept text only through stdin; do not accept file paths.
Support either one file path or stdin.
